maintenance_led.reason: Mostly welding equipment and consumables sold to fabricators and industry, plus gas control products; largely new equipment and consumables, not repair.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private fabricators, manufacturers, industrial and medical gas users; not mainly government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its welding brands and product launches, with only occasional bolt-on acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Welding equipment and consumables are fairly interchangeable among suppliers; gas control and inspection are niche, but fabrication is larger.

notes: Mission-critical is borderline: welding consumables can be qualified into procedures, and gas control serves safety uses.
